name: bidskim
description: UK public procurement intelligence: search live UK government tenders from Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland and Sell2Wales; track contract renewals with incumbent suppliers and expiry dates; and research public-sector buyers and suppliers. Adds three workflow skills for building a renewal pipeline, scanning tenders that fit what you sell, and briefing a buyer before you bid. Connects to BidSkim's hosted MCP server (OAuth sign-in; BidSkim Predict plan required).
